key.name: status-file-path
key.description: Absolute path to status.json. Empty means $XDG_DATA_HOME/ai-usage-module/status.json.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: Fallback polling interval for reloading status.json (changes are also picked up via a file monitor).

key.name: panel-profile-ids
key.description: Profile ids shown on the top bar. Empty means the first profile of each provider.

key.name: refresh-command
key.description: Command run by "Refresh now" to update status.json.
